description: This file declares the class AdbInterfaceObject, which encapsulates a USB interface on an Android device, providing methods to retrieve interface details, descriptors, and manage endpoints.

classes.name: AdbInterfaceObject
classes.description: An abstract class representing a USB interface on an Android device, providing methods to access interface details and manage endpoints.

methods.name: AdbInterfaceObject(const wchar_t* interf_name)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface object with a given interface name.

methods.name: virtual ~AdbInterfaceObject()
methods.description: Destructor, protected to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of the interface's device, with options for ANSI or wide character string.

methods.name: GetEndpointInformation
methods.description: Gets information about a specific endpoint on this interface.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens an endpoint on this interface with specified access and sharing modes.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the USB interface.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Gets the USB device descriptor associated with this interface.

methods.name: GetUsbConfigurationDescriptor
methods.description: Gets the USB configuration descriptor for this interface.

methods.name: GetUsbInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Gets the descriptor for this interface.
